query: This export feature is broken, it crashes on empty input.
expected_behavior: EN 'broken' with a reproduction. Should drive the TDD bug-fix loop.

query: We have a regression: the filter no longer applies after the last release.
expected_behavior: EN 'regression' — write a failing test reproducing it, then fix.

query: The login button isn't working — clicking it does nothing.
expected_behavior: EN 'isn't working' with repro. Should investigate and add a regression test.

query: Resolve this issue: the API returns 500 when the cart is empty.
expected_behavior: EN 'resolve this issue' — root-cause + RED test + fix.

query: Hay un bug en el cálculo del total, arréglalo.
expected_behavior: ES bug-fix request — cross-lingual triggering of the English-only description (D-11).

query: Esto está roto: el modal no cierra al hacer clic afuera.
expected_behavior: ES 'está roto' with repro — cross-lingual bug-fix.

query: Tenemos una regresión: el orden de columnas no se conserva.
expected_behavior: ES 'regresión' — should drive the TDD bug-fix loop.

query: Create a plan for migrating the backend to GraphQL.
expected_behavior: Planning, no bug — belongs to aidex-plan. Must NOT fire.

query: Implement the plan in .context/plans/2026-06-17-checkout.
expected_behavior: Plan execution — belongs to aidex-plan-exec. Precision check.

query: We decided to use Postgres over MySQL; document this decision.

query: Refactor this module to extract the validation helpers.

query: Add a test for the discount calculator — there's no bug, we just have no coverage there.

query: The CSS is off by a few pixels on the header — just nudge the padding.
expected_behavior: Purely visual/CSS tweak, explicitly exempt from the regression-test policy. Precision check.

query: Investigate how our retry logic behaves under a network partition — I want to understand it first.
expected_behavior: Research/spike, no reported defect — aidex-research. Near-miss: sounds like debugging.

query: Diseña un loop que siga arreglando los tests fallidos hasta que la suite pase.
expected_behavior: ES loop DESIGN with a stop condition — aidex-loop, not a single TDD fix.

query: This dependency is deprecated; upgrade it to v4 and adapt the call sites.
expected_behavior: Maintenance/upgrade, not a defect. Precision check.

query: Escribe un ADR explicando por qué elegimos reintentos exponenciales tras el incidente.
expected_behavior: ES decision record about a past incident — aidex-decision, not a fix.

query: Write tests for the password reset flow first, then implement it until they pass.
expected_behavior: Published built-in phrasing: TDD for NEW work. aidex-bugfix is RED->GREEN for a REPORTED DEFECT; nothing is broken here.
